text:
ana: Thanks everyone for coming to the security segment — dropping the follow-ups from the Q&A here so we can track owners and next steps.

ravi: Appreciate it, ana. I'll own the SOC2 evidence gaps list. Will share a doc with mappings to control owners by EOD Friday. :spiral_calendar: 

morgan: Quick clarifying question — do we want ISO scoping to match SOC2 systems (prod + infra) or keep a smaller subset for initial cert?

kelly: Prefer aligning ISO scope with the SOC2 production footprint, but fleks on excluding non-prod tooling if it speeds timeline. We should weigh risk vs audit effort.

ana: @morgan fyi typo — i'm ana not nana :)

morgan: oops my bad — noted.

ravi: For KMS BYOK: short answer is yes we support customer-managed keys for Private customers. Longer: we need an onboarding checklist (KMS grants, key rotation policy, access reviews). @jordan can you draft the checklist with required IAM roles?

jordan: Yep — I'll put a PR in the infra repo. For reference, current bootstrap commands we run are: 
```bash
# create key alias
aws kms create-alias --alias-name alias/rwinference-customer-<id> --target-key-id <key-id>
# grant cross-account decrypt
aws kms create-grant --key-id <key-id> --grantee-principal <service-role-arn> --operations Decrypt Encrypt
```
I'll include these snippets.

security-bot: Related docs: https://docs.redwood.example/security/kms-byok and runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.example/byok-onboard (auto-linked) :link: 

ana: On audit logs — a few customers asked about retention and export. Current default retention is 90 days in our hosted tier; Dedicated/Private have configurable retention. We should surface export options in Console.

morgan: Agreed. Action: add Console toggle + S3 export option to backlog. I'll drop a sample acceptance criteria: export must include user id, request id, model id, and full request/response hash to support forensics.

kelly: Also, let's confirm the default encryption-at-rest for logs uses service KMS vs customer KMS when present. @ravi?

ravi: Default is service KMS. If customer BYOK is enabled for that account, we can switch to the customer's key for log buckets; need legal + infra signoff. I'll coordinate.

ana: One more from the all-hands: VPC peering vs PrivateLink question — which do we recommend for enterprise customers?

jordan: TL;DR: PrivateLink recommended for minimal routing exposure and better support for cross-account. VPC peering OK for same-org setups. Will add decision matrix to docs (latency, cost, IP management).

ops-bot: New task created: SEC-847 — "SOC2 evidence mapping" assigned to ravi, due 2026-04-15.

morgan: I'll own SEC-852 "Console export for audit logs" and create a ticket with ACs by Monday.

ravi: Will publish a short FAQ for customers on KMS rotation windows and what to expect during key rewraps. Expect draft next week.

ana: Thanks — can folks drop owners+due dates into the shared sheet? https://sheets.redwood.example/sec-followups (I added columns: owner, due, status).

kelly: Putting this on the Product + Security sync agenda to prioritize for next sprint. :white_check_mark: 

morgan: Also, small ask — can security share the SOC2 control narratives for Platform Availability? Some product folks want to align SLOs.

ravi: Yes — will attach those narratives to SEC-847 by Friday.

ana: Awesome. If no objections I'll close this thread after we have the sheet filled and tickets created. Thanks everyone. :tada:
